decision_conditions: The development shall be designed and constructed to ensure that the internal consumption of potable water does not exceed 105 litres per person per day. This shall be achieved through the installation of water-efficient fittings, appliances, and, where applicable, water recycling systems. The development shall be maintained in accordance with these measures for the lifetime of the development.Reason: In the interest of sustainable development and to ensure that the Local Planning Authority may be satisfied that CO2 emission reduction targets are met in accordance with Policy CP21 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), Policy DMD58 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014)

The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice.Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans as set out in the attached schedule which forms part of this notice.D100 - Cover PageD101 - Existing Ground Floor PlanD102 - Existing First Floor PlanD103 - Existing Second Floor PlanD104 - Existing Third Floor PlanD105 - Existing Roof PlanD106 - Existing Front ElevationD107 - Existing Rear ElevationD108 - Existing Side ElevationD109 - Existing Section AAD110 - Existing Section BBD111 - Existing Front Street Scene ElevationD112 - Existing Rear Street Scene ElevationD113 - Proposed Third Floor PlanD114 - Proposed Roof PlanD115 - Proposed Front ElevationD116 - Proposed Rear ElevationD117 - Proposed Side ElevationD118 - Proposed Section AAD119 - Proposed Section BBD120 - Proposed Front Street Scene ElevationD121 - Proposed Rear Street Scene ElevationDesign and Access Statement Heritage Statement Energy Statement   Flood Risk Assessment   Highway Proforma Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Notwithstanding the approved drawings, prior to the construction of the roof extension, detailed drawings of the proposed roof extension shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include:o	the roof ridge profile;o	the precise alignment and height of the ridge;o	sections through the roof extension;o	details of the junction between the flat roof and pitched roof elements; ando	confirmation of the final roof form consistent with the approved elevations.The development shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory external appearance and to preserve the character and appearance of the Enfield Town Conservation Area.

Prior to their  first use in the development, a schedule specifying all external materials, together with large-scale drawings of the dormer windows (including elevations and sections), shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The schedule shall include details such as manufacturer, product name or reference number (where applicable), material specification, finish, and colour, together with precedent imagery where appropriate. The development shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved details and permanently retained as such.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory external appearance and to preserve the character and appearance of the Enfield Town Conservation Area.

Having regard to condition 4, prior to the commencement of works utilising external materials, sample panels of 1 square metre minimum shall be erected on site to show areas of new, exterior walling, and approved in writing by the local planning authority. These panels shall indicate brick size, colour, texture and bond together with mortar mix, joint size, colour and pointing profile. Upon approval the sample panels shall be retained on site for reference for the duration of works unless otherwise agreed in writing with the local planning authority. The works shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and shall be permanently maintained as such.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory external appearance and to preserve the character and appearance of the Enfield Town Conservation Area.

The development hereby approved shall be carried out in full accordance with the Energy Statement prepared by Airtight Building Solutions, dated 12/02/2026, unless otherwise submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The approved measures for reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency, including but not limited to the use of low and zero carbon technologies, enhanced building fabric performance, and energy-efficient systems, shall be fully implemented prior to first occupation of the development and retained thereafter.Reason: In the interest of sustainable development and to ensure that the Local Planning Authority may be satisfied that CO2 emission reduction targets are met in accordance with Policy CP20 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), Policies DMD49, DMD50 and DMD51 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

Following practical completion of works a final Energy Performance Certificate with accompanying Building Regulations compliance report shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Where applicable, a Display Energy Certificate shall be submitted within 18 months following first occupation.Reason: In the interest of sustainable development and to ensure that the Local Planning Authority may be satisfied that CO2 emission reduction targets are met in accordance with Policy CP20 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), Policies DMD49, DMD50 and DMD51 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

The development shall not commence until a Construction Management Plan has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The Construction Management Plan shall be written in accordance with London Best Practice Guidance and contain:o	A photographic condition survey of the public roads, footways and verges leading to the site;o	Details of construction access and associated traffic management;o	Arrangements for the loading, unloading and turning of delivery, construction and service vehicles;o	Arrangements for the parking of contractors' vehicles;o	Arrangements for wheel cleaning;o	Arrangements for the storage of materials;o	Hours of work;o	The storage and removal of excavation material;o	Measures to reduce danger to cyclists;o	Dust mitigation measures;o	Membership of the Considerate Contractors SchemThe development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Construction Management Plan unless otherwise agreed by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To ensure construction does not lead to damage of the nearby public road network and to minimise disruption to the neighbouring properties.

Prior to first occupation, details of refuse and recycling storage facilities shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include:o location and layout of refuse storage facilities;o the number, size and type of bins to be provided;o capacity calculations demonstrating adequate provision for all approved residential units within the building;o collection arrangements and collection point details.The development shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved details and retained as such.Reason: In order to facilitate efficient, safe and clean removal of household refuse, the location and accessibility of refuse storage plus to maintain safety on the Highway.
